t: The LED iSpot II Frameless Floodlight with PIR is an efficient and secure lighting solution for residential applications, delivering 2,200 lumens from 20W with 4000K cool white light and a wide 120° beam angle. Designed to meet the latest ErP regulations, it features a high-quality black aluminium body, toughened glass lens, and a fully adjustable mounting bracket. With an integrated PIR sensor, on-board 220–240V driver, condensation release valve, IP65 protection, and 0.5m power flex, to ensure reliable outdoor performance.
